detail.name: Aero
detail.public_notice: Aerodrome Finance (AERO) has been rebranded to Aero (AERO). They migrated from their old contract to a new contract. For more information, please visit this post and visit the old token page here.

description.en: Aero is the unified liquidity layer for all of Ethereum: a cross-network digital asset exchange delivering institutional-grade execution, efficiency, and automation. Its combination of leading technology and economic innovation makes Aero the onchain venue for users, agents, and protocols to trade, earn, and launch digital assets onchain.
